compiled_state.description:
Residual acceptance criterion split from witted-invisible-roan at close assessment on 2026-09-06/07.

Residual AC verbatim from parent:

AC5 [non-codebase]: the measurement campaign has produced the numbers the OOM decision needs — peak MCP RSS during a gate, steady-state RSS per container, and how RSS scales with ticket size. Verified by a comment on this ticket recording those figures.

Context:
- The parent has landed the serving-path alarm, retire-sweep fix, memory instrumentation, GATE_PEAK_RSS marker, and reduced whole-store read footprint (change 2685 merged with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1).
- Evidence now available on the parent includes CloudWatch memory metrics, per-container RSS, several GATE_PEAK_RSS samples, the linear whole-store-read RSS model, and proof that the original Python-object leak premise was false.
- What remains is a longer-horizon capacity/measurement campaign: steady-state per-container RSS across representative load windows and a defensible RSS-vs-ticket-size curve (or evidence that peak RSS is not ticket-size-sensitive after the 2685 reduction).
- This is deliberately non-codebase/capacity evidence, not a code fix; the parent can close once this residual campaign is tracked here.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Record peak MCP/gate RSS, steady-state per-container RSS, and RSS-vs-ticket-size/capacity figures sufficient to choose a memory limit, instance size, or concurrency limit from data rather than guesswork.
- [ ] Post the measurement method, time window, source commands/log queries, and caveats as comments on this ticket.
- [ ] Link any resulting implementation/design tickets discovered from this campaign.
